title: Game Doesn't Close Properly in Web Editor
body:
### Tested versions

- able to reproduce on the web versions of 
  - 4.4.1.stable.official (as a Webapp, and not as a Webapp) 
  - 4.3.official.stable (only as a webapp)
- have not tested lower versions. (don't really have the time to.)

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Web (ChromeOS Version 134.0.6998.130)  - Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL ES 3 (Compatibility) - WebKit WebGL -  (2 threads)

### Issue description

> [!NOTE]
> I use a School Chromebook that came has GoGuardian
> I'm not exactly sure if GoGuardian causes this or if its exclusive to my Chromebook.

When running the game in the Godot Web Editor, closing the "Game" tab on *some* projects does not actually close the game, but rather shows the last frame of the game before pressing the X or stopping the project. 

When this happens, the Run Game button turns into a glorified save current scene button, as the Game tab does not update after rerunning the game.

For some reason, this does not affect my new projects until I have some sort of error (I.e. running out of memory, or just randomly... I think this laptop really doesn't like Godot.).

### Steps to reproduce

I don't know what steps I took cause this on *new* projects.
Here's a recording of the bug on 4.4.1. (also, my mouse *isn't* that big)
